typical_devices: Toyota/Lexus RKE fob (314.35 MHz); Honda/Acura RKE (313.85 MHz); Ford/Lincoln/Mercury RKE (315.0 MHz); GM/Chevrolet/Cadillac (315.0 MHz); Genie/Liftmaster garage door opener (315 MHz); Texas Instruments CC1101 eval board; Flipper Zero Sub-GHz (Read/Replay 315 MHz); RTL-SDR dongle + URH (decoding)
modulation: OOK (On-Off Keying) / ASK; some FSK (newer fobs with rolling code)
power_limit: -1 dBm (FCC Part 15.231, field strength 6000 μV/m at 3m)
notes: NOT legal for TX in EU. Common protocols: KeeLoq (Microchip), AUT64 (HCS series), Fixed code. Flipper Zero can read/replay fixed-code fobs. Rolling codes (KeeLoq) require protocol-level replay tools. TPMS: 314 MHz band uses FSK with vehicle-specific ID.

typical_devices: Honeywell KGS-440 glide slope receiver; Garmin GS-48 (general aviation); Collins GLS-350; Thales TLS-755 ILS transmitter ground station; RTL-SDR (receive only, monitoring)
modulation: DSB-AM with 90 Hz and 150 Hz tones (DDM = Difference in Depth of Modulation)
regulatory_ref: ICAO Annex 10 Vol I / ICAO Doc 9365 / ITU-R M.825
notes: 40 channels: 329.15-335.0 MHz (150 kHz spacing). Paired with ILS LOC (108-112 MHz). 90 Hz tone = above glide path, 150 Hz = below. RECEIVE ONLY — never transmit in this band. FAA/EUROCONTROL protected.

typical_devices: Motorola MTP3550 TETRA portable; Sepura STP9100; Hytera PD685G TETRA; Airbus Tactilon Agnet; Kenwood TK-5320; FR: Polycom ANTARES network terminals; DE: BDBOS BOSnet subscriber units; UK: Airwave Sepura SC21; CH: Polycom network (Ericsson infrastructure)
modulation: π/4-DQPSK; TDMA 4 timeslots per 25 kHz carrier
notes: UL: 380-385 MHz (MS→BS), DL: 390-395 MHz (BS→MS), duplex spacing 10 MHz. TDMA: 4 users/carrier. TETRA V+D (voice+data) and TEDS (data enhanced). LICENSED ONLY — national emergency service assignment. Receive-only listening is legal in most EU countries. Countries: FR=ANTARES, DE=BOSnet/BDBOS, UK=Airwave (migrating to ESN/4G), CH=Polycom, ES=SIRDEE, IT=national networks.

typical_devices: Flipper Zero (Flipper Devices Inc.) with CC1101 sub-GHz module; Flipper Zero + Wi-Fi Dev Board (ESP32-S2); Flipper Zero + NRF24 module (2.4 GHz); Flipper Zero + Video Game Module (GPIO)
modulation: OOK/ASK/FSK/2-FSK/4-FSK (CC1101 chip); read+replay mode; RAW capture mode
power_limit: TX: ~+10 dBm (10 mW) typical; RX sensitivity: ~-107 dBm
regulatory_ref: Texas Instruments CC1101 datasheet / Flipper Zero FCC ID: 2A7RH-FLIPPER-ZERO
notes: CC1101 chip: 300-348 MHz / 387-464 MHz / 779-928 MHz. Key features: read/save/replay sub-GHz remotes (OOK fixed code); RAW capture; built-in protocols (Princeton, CAME, NICE, etc.); frequency analyzer (spectrum). CANNOT decode rolling-code security systems without additional tools. Add-on modules extend to NFC (13.56 MHz), IR (38 kHz), iButton (1-Wire), RFID (125 kHz EM4100).
